subject: 浑源悬空寺现存明清崖壁建筑群
caption: 悬空寺 · 崖壁建筑群
明清遗构 · 南北楼与凌空栈道
author: Yumeto；Dudva

sources.author: Yumeto
sources.role: 完整建筑组合、山崖位置关系与高差

sources.author: Dudva
sources.role: 近正面楼阁、步道、支撑柱细节

source_note: 两张实拍交叉核对现存建筑组合：左侧院落、中央南楼、右侧较高北楼及相连栈道。生成图保留两个三层飞楼、长立柱、台基与少量岩层轮廓。时代取现存明清木构，北魏仅为创建沿革，不能用于所绘主体着色。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject-specific requirements: Hunyuan Xuankong Si, the Hanging Temple clinging to a vertical rock face. The two actual photos show the SAME complex: use image 2 for complete extent and image 3 for structural details. Draw the whole historically important continuous composition: at left the lower long main courtyard building with a small projecting tower at each end, behind it smaller roofed cliff cells; in the middle a tall three-level pavilion; to the right and higher a second three-level pavilion. Preserve the two slim cliffside walkways, their upward slope between the pavilions, railings, and the long slender vertical timber poles down to the rock below. Keep the real asymmetric stepped arrangement and the number of visible pavilion levels. Under the left group retain the simple outline of its masonry podium without dense masonry lines. Crucially retain several sparse, long diagonal stratification contours and the concave rock shelter immediately behind and below the buildings, so this is unmistakably a cliff-hanging structure. Do NOT surround it with a landscape, do not depict a whole mountain, and do not convert the rock into a flat courtyard or freestanding temple. Remove all visitors and the giant inscribed boulder. Leave cliff rock and shadowed windows pure white. Roof detail is sparse and fine, no heavy black under-eave strips, no exhaustive tiles. Wide landscape canvas 1536x1024. Entire complex approximately 84% of canvas width, with generous blank margin, no clipping; slightly elevated viewpoint from across the valley close to the photos, retaining near-frontal facade geometry.

historical_sources.title: 大同市浑源县文物保护利用示范区
historical_sources.evidence: 文物介绍表悬空寺条明确记载：据《恒山志》始建于北魏晚期，经历代重修，现存建筑皆明清遗构；坐西朝东，自南向北一字排开，渐次增高。

historical_sources.title: 悬空寺
historical_sources.evidence: 总体布局分寺院与南北二楼；南北楼三层叠起，栈道相连；最高层三教殿合祀释迦牟尼、老子、孔子。

historical_sources.title: Hanging Temple 坐标
historical_sources.evidence: 遗址位置39°39′34.4″N,113°42′30.11″E；采用该位置，旧中文百科坐标与实景拍摄地点有明显偏移，不使用。

site_recommendation.name: 悬空寺
site_recommendation.sub: 绝壁楼阁 · 三教合一
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1600仅为明清现存建筑的年表约略定位，不是确切修建年份。北魏为创建沿革。
site_recommendation.place: 山西浑源 · 恒山金龙峡
site_recommendation.lede: 两座三层飞楼贴着绝壁渐次升高，狭窄栈道把殿阁串联起来。细长立柱与伸入山岩的构架，共同构成悬空寺轻巧而险峻的轮廓。

facts.label: 明清遗构
facts.text: 寺院有北魏创建的沿革，现存建筑则为历代重修后的明清遗构。图版按现存主体断代。

facts.label: 南北二楼
facts.text: 南北两座三层楼阁高低错落，以贴崖栈道相连，左侧另有较低的寺院建筑。

facts.label: 三教同殿
facts.text: 最高处的三教殿合祀释迦牟尼、老子与孔子，体现儒、释、道共处的寺院格局。
